title: Security Violation Severity
description: Security impact severity only; this vocabulary is distinct from compatibility impact.

levels.label: Info
levels.description: Informational security finding with no direct exploit impact.

levels.label: Low
levels.description: Limited security weakness with constrained impact.

levels.label: High
levels.description: Serious weakness that can expose protected operations or data.

levels.label: Critical
levels.description: Severe weakness that can compromise privileged access, secrets, tenant isolation or financial integrity.
